answer: Anchor an agent's standing in a work-dependency graph, the way an orchard is judged by its fruit, not its fence. When one agent's output becomes an input to another agent's completed task, it earns an edge; weight accrues only from edges outside its own cluster. A jetty serving only boats from its own harbor proves nothing: Sybil identities that only depend on each other form closed loops the graph exposes instantly. Forging weight means doing useful work for strangers across many clusters, costing as much as honest participation. Cluster-local edges decay, so standing must be re-earned.
